16: // Package machineinfo provides a shim layer over gpud's machine-info package
17: // to customize version information for GPU Health.
18: package machineinfo
19: 
20: import (
21: 	"fmt"
22: 	"io"
23: 
24: 	"github.com/dustin/go-humanize"
25: 	apiv1 "github.com/leptonai/gpud/api/v1"
26: 	pkgmachineinfo "github.com/leptonai/gpud/pkg/machine-info"
27: 	nvidianvml "github.com/leptonai/gpud/pkg/nvidia-query/nvml"
28: 	"github.com/leptonai/gpud/pkg/providers"
29: 	"github.com/olekukonko/tablewriter"
30: 	metav1 "k8s.io/apimachinery/pkg/apis/meta/v1"
31: 
32: 	"github.com/NVIDIA/gpuhealth/internal/version"
33: )
34: 
35: // MachineInfo is a custom struct that replaces GPUdVersion with GPUHealthVersion
36: type MachineInfo struct {
37: 	// GPUHealthVersion represents the current version of GPU Health agent
38: 	GPUHealthVersion string `json:"gpuHealthVersion,omitempty"`
39: 	// GPUDriverVersion represents the current version of GPU driver installed
40: 	GPUDriverVersion string `json:"gpuDriverVersion,omitempty"`
41: 	// CUDAVersion represents the current version of cuda library.
42: 	CUDAVersion string `json:"cudaVersion,omitempty"`
43: 	// ContainerRuntime Version reported by the node through runtime remote API (e.g. containerd://1.4.2).
44: 	ContainerRuntimeVersion string `json:"containerRuntimeVersion,omitempty"`
45: 	// Kernel Version reported by the node from 'uname -r' (e.g. 3.16.0-0.bpo.4-amd64).
46: 	KernelVersion string `json:"kernelVersion,omitempty"`
47: 	// OS Image reported by the node from /etc/os-release (e.g. Debian GNU/Linux 7 (wheezy)).
48: 	OSImage string `json:"osImage,omitempty"`
49: 	// The Operating System reported by the node
50: 	OperatingSystem string `json:"operatingSystem,omitempty"`
51: 	// SystemUUID comes from https://github.com/google/cadvisor/blob/master/utils/sysfs/sysfs.go#L442
52: 	SystemUUID string `json:"systemUUID,omitempty"`
53: 	// MachineID is collected by GPUd. It comes from /etc/machine-id or /var/lib/dbus/machine-id
54: 	MachineID string `json:"machineID,omitempty"`
55: 	// BootID is collected by GPUd.
56: 	BootID string `json:"bootID,omitempty"`
57: 	// Hostname is the current host of machine
58: 	Hostname string `json:"hostname,omitempty"`
59: 	// Uptime represents when the machine up
60: 	Uptime metav1.Time `json:"uptime,omitempty"`
61: 
62: 	// CPUInfo is the CPU info of the machine.
63: 	CPUInfo *apiv1.MachineCPUInfo `json:"cpuInfo,omitempty"`
64: 	// MemoryInfo is the memory info of the machine.
65: 	MemoryInfo *apiv1.MachineMemoryInfo `json:"memoryInfo,omitempty"`
66: 	// GPUInfo is the GPU info of the machine.
67: 	GPUInfo *apiv1.MachineGPUInfo `json:"gpuInfo,omitempty"`
68: 	// DiskInfo is the Disk info of the machine.
69: 	DiskInfo *apiv1.MachineDiskInfo `json:"diskInfo,omitempty"`
70: 	// NICInfo is the network info of the machine.
71: 	NICInfo *apiv1.MachineNICInfo `json:"nicInfo,omitempty"`
72: }
73: 
74: // GetMachineInfo retrieves machine info and customizes it for GPU Health
75: func GetMachineInfo(nvmlInstance nvidianvml.Instance) (*MachineInfo, error) {
76: 	// Get the original machine info from gpud
77: 	gpudInfo, err := pkgmachineinfo.GetMachineInfo(nvmlInstance)
78: 	if err != nil {
79: 		return nil, err
80: 	}
81: 
82: 	// Convert to our custom MachineInfo struct with GPU Health version
83: 	return &MachineInfo{
84: 		GPUHealthVersion:        version.Version,
85: 		GPUDriverVersion:        gpudInfo.GPUDriverVersion,
86: 		CUDAVersion:             gpudInfo.CUDAVersion,
87: 		ContainerRuntimeVersion: gpudInfo.ContainerRuntimeVersion,
88: 		KernelVersion:           gpudInfo.KernelVersion,
89: 		OSImage:                 gpudInfo.OSImage,
90: 		OperatingSystem:         gpudInfo.OperatingSystem,
91: 		SystemUUID:              gpudInfo.SystemUUID,
92: 		MachineID:               gpudInfo.MachineID,
93: 		BootID:                  gpudInfo.BootID,
94: 		Hostname:                gpudInfo.Hostname,
95: 		Uptime:                  gpudInfo.Uptime,
96: 		CPUInfo:                 gpudInfo.CPUInfo,
97: 		MemoryInfo:              gpudInfo.MemoryInfo,
98: 		GPUInfo:                 gpudInfo.GPUInfo,
99: 		DiskInfo:                gpudInfo.DiskInfo,
100: 		NICInfo:                 gpudInfo.NICInfo,
101: 	}, nil
102: }
103: 
104: // RenderTable renders the machine info table with GPU Health branding
105: func (i *MachineInfo) RenderTable(wr io.Writer) {
106: 	if i == nil {
107: 		return
108: 	}
109: 
110: 	table := tablewriter.NewWriter(wr)
111: 	table.SetAlignment(tablewriter.ALIGN_CENTER)
112: 
113: 	// Show GPU Health Version instead of GPUd Version
114: 	table.Append([]string{"GPUHealth Version", i.GPUHealthVersion})
115: 	table.Append([]string{"Container Runtime Version", i.ContainerRuntimeVersion})
116: 	table.Append([]string{"OS Image", i.OSImage})
117: 	table.Append([]string{"Kernel Version", i.KernelVersion})
118: 
119: 	if i.CPUInfo != nil {
120: 		table.Append([]string{"CPU Type", i.CPUInfo.Type})
121: 		table.Append([]string{"CPU Manufacturer", i.CPUInfo.Manufacturer})
122: 		table.Append([]string{"CPU Architecture", i.CPUInfo.Architecture})
123: 		table.Append([]string{"CPU Logical Cores", fmt.Sprintf("%d", i.CPUInfo.LogicalCores)})
124: 	}
125: 	if i.MemoryInfo != nil {
126: 		table.Append([]string{"Memory Total", humanize.IBytes(i.MemoryInfo.TotalBytes)})
127: 	}
128: 
129: 	table.Append([]string{"CUDA Version", i.CUDAVersion})
130: 	if i.GPUInfo != nil {
131: 		table.Append([]string{"GPU Driver Version", i.GPUDriverVersion})
132: 		table.Append([]string{"GPU Product", i.GPUInfo.Product})
133: 		table.Append([]string{"GPU Manufacturer", i.GPUInfo.Manufacturer})
134: 		table.Append([]string{"GPU Architecture", i.GPUInfo.Architecture})
135: 		table.Append([]string{"GPU Memory", i.GPUInfo.Memory})
136: 	}
137: 
138: 	if i.NICInfo != nil {
139: 		for idx, nic := range i.NICInfo.PrivateIPInterfaces {
140: 			table.Append([]string{fmt.Sprintf("Private IP Interface %d", idx+1), fmt.Sprintf("%s (%s, %s)", nic.Interface, nic.MAC, nic.IP)})
141: 		}
142: 	}
143: 
144: 	if i.DiskInfo != nil {
145: 		table.Append([]string{"Container Root Disk", i.DiskInfo.ContainerRootDisk})
146: 	}
147: 
148: 	table.Render()
149: 	fmt.Fprintf(wr, "\n")
150: 
151: 	if i.DiskInfo != nil {
152: 		i.DiskInfo.RenderTable(wr)
153: 		fmt.Fprintf(wr, "\n")
154: 	}
155: 
156: 	if i.GPUInfo != nil {
157: 		i.GPUInfo.RenderTable(wr)
158: 		fmt.Fprintf(wr, "\n")
159: 	}
160: }
161: 
162: // GetProvider is a passthrough to gpud's GetProvider function
163: func GetProvider(publicIP string) *providers.Info {
164: 	return pkgmachineinfo.GetProvider(publicIP)
165: }
